newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Swedish March PPI seen rising 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Swedish March PPI seen rising 0.4 pct.

text.p: Sweden's producer price index was expected to rise 0.4 percent in March which would give a fall of 1.2 percent for the 12 month period to the end of March, a Reuter poll showed on Friday.
Forecasts varied between a rise of 0.1 to 0.7 percent for the month for a year-on-year figure of between minus 1.5 and minus 0.8 percent.
In February this year producer prices rose 0.4 percent for a fall of 1.8 percent in the 12 month period.
Producer prices fell 0.3 percent in March 1996 for a year-on-year figure of 0.3 percent.
Statistics Sweden will release the PPI for March at 0805 GMT on April 25.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Carnegie, Consensus, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, JP Morgan, Morgan Stanley, Nomura, PaineWebber, and Unibank.
